spec_match.rationale: Builds the spec's flagship tabs-mode use case (a real tabbed panel) on the exact declaration 'scroll-marker-group: before tabs' and maps each §3.1.6 contract to an observation method instead of asserting behaviour parsing cannot prove.

interactive.rationale: Mode switcher re-declares the property live, panels contain working form controls with save actions and per-panel output, and the focus trace reports real focusin events during keyboard use.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises a settings panel with no tab markup and a parse-vs-behave banner; both are on the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Three honest states: full support, parse-only (with explicit warning that semantics may not follow), and mode-keyword-rejected fallback to the base declaration; the pseudo-element focus reporting limitation is labelled in the trace.

references.rationale: Links the chromestatus entry, the scroll-marker-modes spec section, and the WAI-ARIA APG tabs pattern.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite covers the exact 'before/after + mode' parse contracts and records the tablist/roving-focus behaviour as a manual assertion with the reason it cannot be scripted.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP run on Chromium 141: mode buttons exercised, save action produced its output, panel scroll driven (scrollLeft advanced to the third panel), focus trace verified against a real input focus, zero console errors, desktop and 360px-DPR3 emulated screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Separate asserts for tabs-mode-parsed-applied, tabs-mode-parse-rejected-fallback, tabs-mode-unsupported-honest, mode-switch outcomes, and panel-save-clicked.

design_system.rationale: All colours from CSS variables; pressed mode buttons and the save button set background and color together; tab markers restate both properties in :target-current.

accessibility.rationale: Every form control has an explicit label, checkboxes are grouped under a described label, buttons expose aria-pressed, focus-visible is styled on buttons, fields, and the ::scroll-marker pseudo, and the trace/status regions are aria-live.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: documentElement.scrollWidth is 360 under 360x740 DPR3 emulation (panels wider than the viewport live inside the scroll container by design); the tab strip is a fixed-height scrollable row so wrapping cannot overlap panel content; controls are 44px.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible tabs keyboard interaction roving tabindex
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Match ARIA implementations to actual behaviour — role=tab must come with the tabs keyboard model — and prefer native/platform mechanisms over hand-rolled ARIA.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The page adds no role attributes at all: the point of tabs mode is that the platform supplies the tablist contract. The contract table tells readers to verify roles in the AX tree instead of trusting parse acceptance, and no ARIA is faked when the mode is unsupported.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Explicitly associate <label> with its control via for/id even when nesting.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Text inputs and selects use for/id pairs; checkbox lines nest the input and reference the group label with aria-describedby.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Flex rows that can overflow need wrap or scrolling; give the marker strip one definite size.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The marker group gets an explicit height (the UA sheet's contain:size makes auto-sizing impossible) with nowrap + overflow-x auto so long tab strips scroll instead of overlapping the panel.

openQuestions.title: Capture the Chrome 154 keyboard evidence for the contract table
openQuestions.detail: On the build browser (Chromium 141) all modes still behave as the legacy tablist-flavoured implementation: CDP AX dumps show tablist/tab roles for links and tabs alike, no tabpanel role, and no pruning. When a Chrome 154 binary is available, walk the focus trace with Tab/arrows in each mode, dump the AX tree, and record where the two modes actually diverge.

summary: Practical tabs-mode demo: a working settings panel whose tab bar is entirely generated, with a three-state honest banner (supported / parses-but-verify-behaviour / rejected-fallback), a live keyboard focus trace, and a contract table that routes each unmeasurable promise to DevTools instead of claiming it.
